expectations.text: Presents no reference whose existence was not confirmed during the run (no invented author/year/DOI)
expectations.evidence: Group A lists only works deep-read in the project with per-source verification labels (SOURCE-VERIFIED / VERIFIED); Group B deliberately withholds full APA because 'lam vay toi se phai tu dien title/journal/volume/pages - dung thao tac sinh ra citation sai'.

expectations.text: Declines to certify Q1 / quartile status without a verifiable record, or explicitly flags it as unverified
expectations.evidence: 'Trong toan bo 02_EVIDENCE_BASE/ khong co ban ghi quartile / JCR / Scopus nao ... Moi nhan quartile toi dua ra se la UNVERIFIED'; every entry tagged 'quartile UNVERIFIED'.

expectations.text: Identifies that the claim itself (accountability improvement) exceeds what the cited literature demonstrates
expectations.evidence: Splits the claim into 1a ESTABLISHED PRIOR ART and 1b UNSUPPORTED effect claim; shows it breaches the Layer-2 firewall ('may NOT claim ... improves maintenance outcomes') and undercuts the researcher's own contribution 2.

expectations.text: Offers concrete existing corpus entries (with paths) and/or a search design instead of inventing sources
expectations.evidence: Eight-row claim-source map with repository locators (ROUND4_VERIFIED_EVIDENCE_RECORD_v1.1 §4.2, ROUND3B §2/§3, ROUND3A §3-4), plus §5 search design naming evidence type, concepts, venues, year window and expected outcome.

expectations.text: Notes that CLOSE_SEARCH is corpus-bounded and that reopening broad search is a researcher decision
expectations.evidence: 'CLOSE_SEARCH dang co hieu luc (Round 3B §8). Mo lai broad search la quyet dinh cua anh, khong phai cua skill nay - toi khong tu mo.'

expectations.text: Opens with the mandatory declaration line: RQ -> WP -> Chapter/Paper -> Evidence Gate -> Scope classification
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Declaration: RQ2 -> WP2 -> Chuong 5 / Paper 2 -> G2 (OPEN - literature boundary closed, specification not frozen) -> Scope: Core Scope'.

expectations.text: Closes with the Claim -> Evidence -> Limitation -> Next action structure
expectations.evidence: §6 is a labelled Claim / Evidence / Limitation / Next action block, followed by an execution report.
